### Never Give Up
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/never-give-up
Passage: 2 Thessalonians 3:13
Points:
- Faulty beliefs in Thessalonica led some believers into idleness and meddling, expecting Christ's immediate return.
- Paul instructs faithful believers not to grow weary while witnessing others abandon their responsibilities.
- The exhortation does not forbid physical tiredness, but warns against losing heart in doing what is right.
- Christians are reminded to persevere because God sees their daily faithfulness and will reward it.

### Laziness Is Profoundly Unchristian
Author: David Mathis
Site: Desiring God
URL: https://www.desiringgod.org/articles/laziness-is-profoundly-unchristian
Passage: 2 Thessalonians 3:6-15
Points:
- A responsible work ethic is deeply spiritual and reflects the fruit of the gospel.
- Idleness harms the church by consuming others' resources and disrupting community peace through meddling.
- Paul distinguishes between those genuinely unable to work and able-bodied individuals unwilling to labor.
- Paul modeled diligent labor himself so that believers would have a tangible example to imitate.
- The indwelling Holy Spirit gradually frees believers from sloth and empowers them to pursue productive good works.
